SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_SURVEY_M001 M WHERE M.sys_id = #{sysId} AND M.del_yn = 'N'
AND M.template_yn = #{templateYn}
AND M.surv_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{survNm}, '%')
AND M.surv_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{survIdSearch}, '%')

SELECT sys_id AS "sysId", surv_id AS "survId", sys_se_cd AS "sysSeCd", surv_nm AS "survNm", surv_expl AS "survExpl", surv_ver AS "survVer", template_yn AS "templateYn", use_yn AS "useYn", start_dt AS "startDt", end_dt AS "endDt" FROM TN_SURVEY_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT sys_id AS "sysId", surv_id AS "survId", qstn_sn AS "qstnSn", qstn_type AS "qstnType", qstn_txt AS "qstnTxt", req_yn AS "reqYn", ord_no AS "ordNo" FROM TN_SURVEY_M002 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId} ORDER BY ord_no ASC, qstn_sn ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TN_SURVEY_M001 ( sys_id, surv_id, sys_se_cd, surv_nm, surv_expl, surv_ver, template_yn, use_yn, del_yn, start_dt, end_dt, frst_rgstr_id, frst_reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{sysId}, #{survId}, #{sysSeCd}, #{survNm}, #{survExpl}, #{survVer}, #{templateYn}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{startDt}NULL, #{endDt}NULL, #{userId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TN_SURVEY_M001 SET surv_nm = #{survNm}, surv_expl = #{survExpl}, use_yn = #{useYn}, sys_se_cd = #{sysSeCd}, start_dt = #{startDt}NULL, end_dt = #{endDt}NULL, last_mdfr_id = #{userId}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TN_SURVEY_M002 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId}
DELETE FROM TN_SURVEY_M003 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId}
mapper.select: SELECT sys_id AS "sysId", surv_id AS "survId", resp_id AS "respId", user_id AS "userId", frst_reg_dt AS "frstRegDt" FROM TN_SURVEY_P001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND surv_id = #{survId} ORDER BY frst_reg_dt DESC

SELECT A.sys_id AS "sysId", A.surv_id AS "survId", A.resp_id AS "respId", A.qstn_sn AS "qstnSn", A.ans_sn AS "ansSn", A.opt_sn AS "optSn", A.ans_txt AS "ansTxt", Q.qstn_type AS "qstnType", Q.qstn_txt AS "qstnTxt", O.opt_txt AS "optTxt" FROM TN_SURVEY_P002 A JOIN TN_SURVEY_M002 Q ON A.sys_id = Q.sys_id AND A.surv_id = Q.surv_id AND A.qstn_sn = Q.qstn_sn LEFT JOIN TN_SURVEY_M003 O ON A.sys_id = O.sys_id AND A.surv_id = O.surv_id AND A.qstn_sn = O.qstn_sn AND A.opt_sn = O.opt_sn WHERE A.sys_id = #{sysId} AND A.surv_id = #{survId} AND A.resp_id = #{respId} ORDER BY A.qstn_sn ASC, A.ans_sn ASC

SELECT Q.qstn_sn AS "qstnSn", Q.qstn_txt AS "qstnTxt", Q.qstn_type AS "qstnType", O.opt_sn AS "optSn", O.opt_txt AS "optTxt", ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_SURVEY_P002 A WHERE A.sys_id = Q.sys_id AND A.surv_id = Q.surv_id AND A.qstn_sn = Q.qstn_sn AND (A.opt_sn = O.opt_sn OR (O.opt_sn IS NULL)) ) AS "ansCnt" FROM TN_SURVEY_M002 Q LEFT JOIN TN_SURVEY_M003 O ON Q.sys_id = O.sys_id AND Q.surv_id = O.surv_id AND Q.qstn_sn = O.qstn_sn WHERE Q.sys_id = #{sysId} AND Q.surv_id = #{survId} ORDER BY Q.qstn_sn ASC, O.ord_no ASC
